name: Final Universal Page Intelligence Freeze Marker

summary.architectural_boundary: Phase 4.5 is permanently frozen as LinkCraftor's universal page classification and routing layer.
summary.purpose: Classify every page independent of niche and route it to the correct extraction pipeline.

freeze_rules: Do not perform semantic reasoning inside Phase 4.5.
Do not perform entity graph construction inside Phase 4.5.
Do not perform link recommendation inside Phase 4.5.
Phase 4.5 must only classify, evaluate and route pages.
All downstream intelligence must consume UnifiedContentDocument objects.
Future page types must extend routing without changing existing architecture.
Website pages and uploaded documents must converge through the Unified Content Contract.
